lean.statement:
theorem exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison_degree
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ≅
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n,
      IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison X F U W g n e

proof.text: Use the affine fibre-product and affine pullback sections lemmas to construct the degree-n isomorphism; verify the pure-tensor normalization on generators and extend by linearity.
